Class ViewLessonsHome

java.lang.Object
guiLessonsHome.ViewLessonsHome
public class ViewLessonsHome extends Object

Title: ViewLessonsHome

Description: The JavaFX view for the Lessons Learned Home page. It lists the lessons written by the current user and provides buttons to create, view/edit, and delete a lesson or to return to the previous page. The class is a singleton-style view: its widgets are static and the layout is built once, the first time the page is displayed.

    • displayLessonsHome

      public static void displayLessonsHome(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user)
      Displays the Lessons Learned Home page. The list is refreshed with the current user's lessons each time the page is shown, and a prompt is displayed when the user has not created any lessons yet.
      Parameters:
      ps - the JavaFX stage on which to show the page
      user - the currently logged-in user

    • fillList

      protected static void fillList(javafx.scene.control.ListView<String> list, List<entityClasses.LessonsLearned> lessonsList)
      Replaces the contents of a list view with one row per lesson. Each row has the form "[title] (ID: [id])" so that the controller can recover the lesson ID from the selected row.
      Parameters:
      list - the list view to fill
      lessonsList - the lessons to display
